The idle-worker completion guard becomes p===n||(...), so its body is skipped when all n workers are idle and can run while other workers remain busy. For a one-worker instance with a pending fetch, the final response raises p to n and skips the only deferred f.fetch() call; the fetch remains pending. With multiple workers, the same body can close the reducer and terminate mappers prematurely. Both consumers and the pending-fetch/close flags are present in the actual minified hunk.

Source edits have no effect on test results
A no-op change passes, or tests exercise a stale binary
Counterexamples: The build step is documented and the verifier always rebuilds; Compiled artifacts are intentional dependencies unrelated to the edited code

exploit_template.goal: Reward reflects whatever stale compiled artifact is loaded rather than the agent's edits.

checklist: Remove stale compiled artifacts from the image
Rebuild extensions inside the verifier before the tests run
fix_pattern.example_diff_or_rule:
+ find /app -name '*.so' -delete
+ pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e /app
fix_pattern.summary: Remove stale compiled artifacts from the image; Rebuild extensions inside the verifier before the tests run

mechanism: Precompiled shared libraries or binaries in the image either already contain the fix or shadow the edited source, masking real changes without an unstated rebuild.

file_regexes.description: Dockerfile builds extensions into the image without cleaning stale artifacts.

trace_command_regexes.description: Trajectory inspects or rebuilds compiled .so extensions.

title: Stale precompiled .so or binary in the container image masks or ignores source edits

steps: Exact distro sub-revision pins, or installs with no index refresh
Parallel builds with no cap, or runtime fetches from live URLs or deprecated APIs
Failures show package-not-found, out-of-memory kills or network errors
Build or oracle outcome varies with host core count or remote availability
Counterexamples: Pinned versions are in a vendored, reproducible mirror; Network access is the stated purpose of the task, and the endpoint is stable and documented
detection_recipe.summary: Exact distro sub-revision pins, or installs with no index refresh; Parallel builds with no cap, or runtime fetches from live URLs or deprecated APIs

exploit_template.goal: Reward depends on external availability and host resources rather than on the solution.

checklist: Bake dependencies and datasets into the image at build time
Cap parallelism to container limits and drop brittle sub-revision pins
fix_pattern.example_diff_or_rule:
- apt-get install -y r-base-core=4.3.3-2build2
+ apt-get update && apt-get install -y r-base-core
fix_pattern.summary: Bake dependencies and datasets into the image at build time; Cap parallelism to container limits and drop brittle sub-revision pins

mechanism: Brittle package revision pins, missing index updates, unbounded parallel builds or live external downloads make the environment or oracle fail for reasons unrelated to the solution.

file_regexes.description: Exact apt package revision pin, unbounded make -j$(nproc), or live external URL dependency.

trace_command_regexes.description: apt fails due to stale package version pin or missing apt-get update.

title: Brittle distro package pins, unbounded parallel builds, or live external URLs break environment/oracle
